fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami Beach adopting prohibition at midnight and broader criticism of Volstead Act enforcement; discussion of a proposed Florida local-option racing bill; comparisons of municipal finances and utility rates (Miami vs. Jacksonville) and criticism of a city bus-operating contract involving Florida Power & Light Company; political coverage related to Miami civic elections and Chamber of Commerce contests; recurring humor/columns (e.g., "Little Geraldine") and advertisements including excursions and local businesses.
